value: Minigirl/guy RPG with giantess boss fights

Caught while trying to steal a vial of DiminiGulp shrinking compound, Miyuki and her crew are captured, shrunken, and forced to complete odd-jobs for the mysterious organisation “Maskarade”. The secret behind the shrinking chemical lies in a connection to a witch cult “RunaMaw”, which seeks to take over the world using an ancient relic.
